buyer_claim: The listing says this camera has an active Canon warranty until June 2025, and the serial number checks out in Canon's database. However, I have reason to believe the serial number plate was swapped from a different unit. The camera I received has a small scratch pattern on the bottom plate inconsistent with the serial number plate being original. I think this is a grey market or refurbished unit with a cloned serial from a US-warranty unit.
seller_response: The serial number is verified by Canon's own system as valid with active warranty. I bought this camera new from B&H Photo, an authorized Canon dealer. The scratch on the bottom is from normal use — cameras sit on tripod plates. The buyer is making unfounded claims about serial number cloning when Canon's own database confirms everything.
